answer: To construct a Sybil-resistant architecture, the mechanism enforces dynamic opportunity-cost bonds where each validator staking collateral ties a unique kernel of operational throughput to an immutable identity anchor. Deviations trigger a subgame-perfect slashing matrix that mathematically penalizes partitioned nodes beyond their aggregate yield, ensuring every marble of split capital faces strictly negative expected attack utility. Consequently, rational adversaries find identity multiplication unprofitable, thereby converging the decentralized game into a robust Nash equilibrium.
